hooks.command: cmd=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); branch=""; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_-])main(:main)?([^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)'; then branch=main; else cur=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ "$cur" = "main" ] && branch=main; fi; if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"git push targets main directly; merge via a PR instead (gh pr merge)\"}}"; else echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"git push to a non-main branch\"}}"; fi
git checkout main 2>/dev/null && git fetch origin 2>/dev/null && git merge --ff-only origin/main 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Switching back to main and syncing...
